search.scope: Public open and closed issues, PRs and discussions indexed by the recorded queries; not a guarantee of exhaustive semantic discovery.

candidates.title: fix(sandbox): verify effective UID/GID after privilege drop
candidates.reason: Privilege-drop checks are useful isolation foundations but do not define workspace none or read-only backing.

candidates.title: sec(sandbox): seccomp filter allows dangerous syscalls (ptrace, mount, unshare, bpf)
candidates.reason: This historical syscall-filter report concerns specific restrictions, not the requested optional stdio profile.

candidates.title: sec(sandbox): reduce SYS_ADMIN and SYS_PTRACE capabilities on sandbox pods
candidates.reason: This historical pod-capability report does not specify Docker workspace-none or image-baked stdio admission.

candidates.title: bug: Landlock ruleset abandoned entirely when a single path does not exist
candidates.reason: A Landlock missing-path failure differs from eliminating writable backing and workspace preparation.

candidates.title: feat(sandbox): support file-level read_only overrides within read_write directories
candidates.reason: File-level deny overrides retain a writable parent workspace and do not supply this profile.

candidates.title: fix(sandbox): two-phase Landlock to fix privilege ordering and add enforcement tests
candidates.reason: Landlock setup ordering and tests do not establish a read-only root or workspace-none mode.

candidates.title: feat: support custom sandbox entrypoint command
candidates.reason: Custom workload command selection addresses argv, not the full no-write and pre-exec boundary.

candidates.title: Proposal: Split Supervisor and Agent into Separate Pods with gVisor Isolation
candidates.reason: The Kubernetes split-pod design concerns topology and mediated egress rather than a Docker no-workspace profile.

candidates.title: feat(policy): define agent-oriented policy modes and safety levels
candidates.reason: Policy presets and safety levels do not require complete read-only backing or exact prepared stdio state.

candidates.title: feat(sandbox): operator-declared skippable bootstrap subsystems
candidates.reason: Delegating bootstrap controls to an outer sandbox does not establish the proposed Docker profile and is not an approved workaround.

candidates.title: feat(policy): add runtime baseline conflict controls
candidates.reason: Baseline-conflict policy controls do not remove mandatory workspace writes or attest complete child mounts.

candidates.title: feat: establish the Isolation Backend interface
candidates.reason: The Isolation Backend interface can host this outcome but does not prescribe a nonwriting workspace-none workload profile.

candidates.title: Support First-Class Shared Filesystem Mounts for HPC Sandboxes
candidates.reason: Shared filesystem provisioning adds mounts, whereas this use case requests no user/shared mounts.

candidates.title: Enforce Sandbox Filesystem Policy on Shared-Mounted HPC Paths
candidates.reason: Restricting shared HPC paths differs from proving no writable child backing anywhere.

candidates.title: feat(sandbox): support gated host mounts through driver_config
candidates.reason: Opt-in host mounts provide external data access rather than a mount-free immutable workload boundary.

candidates.title: feat(drivers): support docker and podman config mounts
candidates.reason: Typed local-driver mount configuration does not supply the no-workspace nonwriting profile.

candidates.title: feat(policy): support signed frozen policy bundles
candidates.reason: Signed policy ceilings are related to immutable policy, not proof of child root, mounts, FDs and exact executable state.

candidates.title: fix(supervisor): drop sandbox child capability bounding set
candidates.reason: Dropping the child capability bounding set addresses one control, not the complete requested profile.

candidates.title: fix(supervisor): wire prepare_supervisor_identity_mount_namespace_from_env
candidates.reason: Preparing SPIFFE identity masking does not establish full child mount and workspace isolation.

candidates.title: rfc-0012: Isolation Backend interface
candidates.reason: RFC 0012 defines general boundary lifecycle and conformance, not this specific read-only workspace-none outcome.

candidates.title: fix(sandbox): acknowledge initial policy load and expose SDK labels
candidates.reason: Acknowledging initial policy load does not attest complete prepared child state or immutable executable identity.

candidates.title: fix(sandbox): acknowledge initial policy revision; expose SDK labels/selectors
candidates.reason: Initial policy revision acknowledgement is a useful component, not a complete nonwriting profile.

candidates.title: [Bug]: ExecSandboxInteractive ignores tty=false and always allocates a PTY
candidates.reason: Honoring tty=false fixes stdio transport but does not remove workspace writes or prove containment.

candidates.title: feat: native Linux compute driver (openshell-driver-oci)
candidates.reason: A native Linux compute driver is a different backend and does not qualify this Docker request.

candidates.title: bug: Kubernetes sandbox crashes EROFS — recursive `chown /sandbox` fails on read-only submounts (0.0.82)
candidates.reason: Handling read-only submounts during Kubernetes workspace ownership changes retains a writable workspace model.

candidates.title: feat: preserve image-declared identity in Docker and Podman
candidates.reason: Image-declared identity and immutable image selection do not remove workspace preparation.

candidates.title: feat: honor OCI WorkingDir for Docker and Podman workspaces
candidates.reason: OCI working-directory support explicitly preserves a writable workspace and maps root to the sandbox directory.

candidates.title: feat(sandbox): honor OCI image working directories
candidates.reason: Docker OCI workdir implementation retains write-access validation rather than workspace none.

candidates.title: feat: add registered trusted workload initialization before Ready
candidates.reason: Trusted initialization authorizes bounded root-owned writes before Ready, rather than a no-write child profile.

candidates.title: feat(sandbox): add trusted workload initialization
candidates.reason: The trusted initialization implementation addresses registered setup writes, not the requested child mount/stdio boundary.

candidates.title: feat(podman): honor OCI image working directories
candidates.reason: The superseded Podman workdir probe validates a writable directory and is not a Docker nonwriting mode.

candidates.title: bug(supervisor): SPIFFE-enabled sandboxes crash because identity mount namespace is never prepared
candidates.reason: SPIFFE namespace startup failure concerns credential masking, not complete root and workspace semantics.

candidates.title: feat: support in-place supervisor upgrade via re-exec
candidates.reason: Supervisor re-exec preserves ongoing workloads; this use case instead requires single-use attempts.

candidates.title: feat(kubernetes): add cni-sidecar supervisor topology
candidates.reason: The CNI-sidecar Kubernetes topology separates network setup but does not define this Docker profile.

candidates.title: CreateSandbox Template and API Cleanup Proposal
candidates.reason: Sandbox template/API restructuring is independent of the concrete nonwriting containment outcome.

candidates.title: Support SPIFFE-backed provider token grants on non-Kubernetes drivers (Docker, Podman, VM)
candidates.reason: SPIFFE provider grants concern credential mediation, while this profile needs no provider credentials.

candidates.title: feat(podman): honor OCI image working directories
candidates.reason: Podman workdir support retains persistent writable workspace semantics and does not satisfy workspace none.

candidates.title: Add identity-bound CAS and secret-free attestation for provider mutations
candidates.reason: Provider-mutation attestation binds credential updates rather than workload pre-exec filesystem/FD state.

candidates.title: Support declarative artifact delivery and stable endpoint for governed sandboxes
candidates.reason: Declarative artifact delivery and stable endpoints address long-running services, not a no-network single stdio process.

candidates.title: feat(sandbox): track exec processes
candidates.reason: Exec process identities and inspection do not provide complete pre-exec containment evidence.

candidates.title: refactor(supervisor): treat sandbox workspace as immutable startup context
candidates.reason: This workspace is an organizational identity context, not removal of the filesystem working directory.

candidates.title: feat: fail-closed capability negotiation for gateway↔supervisor signals under version skew
candidates.reason: Version-skew negotiation is related infrastructure but does not specify the full nonwriting profile.

candidates.title: feat(docker): isolate workloads behind a companion supervisor
candidates.reason: The open Docker companion-supervisor PR separates mediation but retains control channels and does not specify workspace none or read-only child backing.

candidates.title: bug(sandbox): supervisor hardcodes /bin/bash and fails to start on images without bash (e.g. Alpine)
candidates.reason: Default shell discovery is unrelated to an explicit static executable requiring no shell.

candidates.title: fix(sandbox): detect an available login shell instead of hardcoding /bin/bash
candidates.reason: Choosing an available default login shell does not implement exact no-shell stdio admission.

candidates.title: refactor(platform)!: make sandbox environments explicitly composed
candidates.reason: Explicit platform compositions reduce implicit grants but do not require workspace none, immutable exec and observed complete child backing.

candidates.title: Trustworthy sandbox attestation: durable operations, applied-state snapshots, complete observations, and exact cleanup receipts
